_source_notes.role_in_the_extends_chain: This document is never itself resolved by ruleset_service._CATALOG -- it exists only as the extends-parent both baseball/us-nfhs and softball/us-nfhs share, so the mechanics common to both sports (7-inning regulation, the walk-off/run-rule/suspension MECHANISM shape, no default courtesy-runner/pitch-count/tiebreaker policy) are defined once. Per CSRN_NFHS_Baseball_Softball_Rules_Engine_Spec_2026 Sec.11: 'Do not create a universal NFHS mercy rule -- the NFHS baseline should provide the mechanism; the active state/tournament profile supplies the thresholds.' runRules/timeLimit/pitchCountPolicy/courtesyRunnerPolicy are therefore intentionally empty/disabled here -- MHSAA's actual numbers land in the baseball/us-ms-mhsaa and softball/us-ms-mhsaa overlays (P6), not here.
_source_notes.minimumRegulationInnings: Spec Sec.11.1 requires 'the trailing team has completed its required turn at bat' before regulation completes when tied, which needs a minimum-innings concept distinct from scheduledInnings for a rain-shortened or run-rule-ended game. Set equal to scheduledInnings (7) as the NFHS default; state/tournament overlays may lower it for a specific shortened-game procedure.
_source_notes.tieBreaker.mode: NONE at the shared baseline: NFHS baseball/softball both continue extra innings normally absent a state-adopted tiebreaker (spec Sec.17.1: 'Continue when tied unless event-specific procedure applies'). The RUNNER_ON_SECOND mode used by MHSAA fast-pitch softball (spec Sec.17.2/17.3) is set on softball's own state overlay (P6), not here, since it is not a baseball rule.
_source_notes.field.doubleFirstBaseRequired: false at NFHS baseline: the double-first-base square is a 2027 baseball rules-book change (spec Sec.18) and, for softball, a state-specific EARLY adoption (MHSAA requires it starting 2026-27 per spec Sec.17.2) rather than an NFHS-wide 2026 requirement. True only on the softball state overlay once MHSAA's value is confirmed (P6).
